services.desc: Subscribe to our newsletter to stay in the loop about upcoming events. And remember to follow us on Instagram. Join Ben Ash of Root Digger Herb Farm for a rich conversation about growing and tending medicinal herbs in the Pacific Northwest. Ben grows beautiful, vibrant herbs using beyond organic requirements near Tumwater, WA. We source many of our herbs from Ben and have been collaborating on his annual CSA since 2023.
